01 / THE KITCHEN

A table set for
the whole night.

Paloma is a neighborhood kitchen shaped by the Mexican coast and the glow of an open flame. We cook slowly, pour generously, and let dinner find its own rhythm.

Our menu follows the market—whole fish, charred fruit, warm tortillas, cold mezcal. Everything is made to pass, tear, dip, and share.
